description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget for editing a task in a task management app. It includes user interface elements for editing task details such as name, notes, due date, due time, and associated list, along with logic for updating the task in the database.

classes.name: EditTaskScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget for editing a task, containing various task properties and a refresh callback.

classes.name: _EditTaskScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the editing form, data loading, date/time pickers, and task updates.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state, sets default date/time, and loads tasks and lists from the database.

methods.name: refreshNotes
methods.description: Asynchronously loads all tasks and lists from the database.

methods.name: _selectDate
methods.description: Displays a date picker dialog for selecting a reminder date.

methods.name: _selectTime
methods.description: Displays a time picker dialog for selecting a reminder time.
